summary_table.note: One row per tier and class. Sources: screen tier L8 (complete cuts and catalogue), L9, L10 (sampled cuts, full catalogues); carrier tier L6 identities, L5 and L8 records, L8 to L10 checkpoints. Labels: E = EXACT, M = MEASURED, A = ARGUED.

1.mobility: mobile (M; hops at zero cost in the balanced regime, E)
1.ballistic: no (largest local exponent 0.97 on resolved windows, M)
1.persistence: anti-persistent: step autocorrelation -0.02 to -0.03 (M); back-hop 0.29 +- 0.03 against 1/6 random (M)
1.median_identity_lifetime: 36 depth = 2 sweeps (ended identities; 90 % 360 depth), flux population decays (CH: e-folding 109 sweeps on the carrier tier)
1.main_creation: pair birth with 5 (0.248) and split of 2 into 1+1 (0.247), L10
1.main_ending: fusion with 1 into 2 (0.300), annihilation with 5 (0.200), fusion with 4 into 5 (0.129), L10
1.pairs: free: sibling (1,5) separation^2 grows without bound, 1.4 -> 47 edges^2 from age 5 to 1500 depth (M)
1.charge_like: hop handedness: steps to the left of the unit flow on every hop (E, checked on all hops); drift to the right of the load gradient, L8 -0.032 +- 0.004 edges per 64 depth (M); no drift along the gradient or toward conjugates (M null)
1.spin_like: none: no curl of trajectories (M null)

5.main_creation: pair birth with 1 (0.248), split of 4 into 5+5 (0.247)
5.main_ending: fusion with 5 into 4 (0.299), annihilation with 1 (0.200), fusion with 2 into 1 (0.129)
5.charge_like: hop handedness opposite to class 1 (E); drift to the left of the load gradient, L8 +0.025 +- 0.003 edges per 64 depth (M)

2.mobility: frozen in the balanced regime (E; MSD = 0 on 0.79 million 64-depth steps at L8, M)
2.median_identity_lifetime: 21 depth = 1 sweep for ended identities (quench contacts); 6.6 % of identities alive at the end and permanent unless a 1 or 5 reaches them (E)
2.main_creation: pair birth with 4 (0.261), fusion 1+1 (0.184), exchange with a 1 (0.140)
2.main_ending: fusion with 5 into 1 (0.159), split into 1+1 (0.152), exchange with 1 (0.140)
2.pairs: frozen at birth separation until a contact; no pairing at the end (CH)
2.charge_like: none resolved (load, bounding-port load, ticks null)

3.median_identity_lifetime: 21 depth; 10 % alive at the end, permanent unless reached by a 1 or 5
3.main_ending: fusion with 5 into 2 (0.149), fusion with 1 into 4 (0.148), split into 1+2 (0.113)
3.charge_like: none; hop handedness undefined (E: j = +3 and -3 are the same class)

4.main_creation: pair birth with 2 (0.262), fusion 5+5 (0.184), exchange with a 5 (0.140)
4.main_ending: fusion with 1 into 5 (0.159), split into 5+5 (0.152), exchange with 5 (0.140)

1.mobility: mobile inside its carrier, confined (E: never leaves the carrier)
1.saturation: MSD -> 7.7 = uniform over the 20 faces (E value, M reached after ~50 sweeps)
1.median_identity_lifetime: 252 depth = 12 sweeps (L6); flux population e-folding 109 sweeps (CH)
1.main_creation: pair birth with 5 (0.371), exchange 2+4 -> 1+5 (0.226), split of 2 (0.126) (L6)
1.main_ending: annihilation with 5 (0.443), fusion with 1 into 2 (0.255), fusion with 4 into 5 (0.116)
1.pairs: bound by confinement (separation <= 5, E); separation distribution relaxes to uniform with d = 1 depleted, mean d^2 8.8 (M)
1.charge_like: hop handedness (E, 1.63 million hops checked); carriers holding it run 2 to 3 fewer clock ticks of 9900 and fewer current events (M, 5 to 15 sigma; selection, A); load null

5.charge_like: opposite hop handedness (E); same clock deficit as class 1 (M)

2.median_identity_lifetime: 66 depth = 3 sweeps for ended identities; 15 % alive at the end and permanent (E once non-adjacent and without 1, 5 on the carrier)
2.main_ending: exchange with 4 into 1+5 (0.300), fusion with 5 into 1 (0.153), alive (0.151)
2.pairs: frozen at separation >= 2 (E: adjacent 2,4 exchange into 1,5)
2.charge_like: none in load or clock; avoids faces with glued ports by 0.26 % (4.8 sigma, L9), template-face occupancy non-uniform at 1 % (M)

3.main_ending: exchange with 3 into 2+4 (0.233), fusion with 1 into 4 (0.099)

4.main_ending: exchange with 2 into 1+5 (0.299), fusion with 1 into 5 (0.153)
4.charge_like: none in load or clock; glued-port avoidance 0.15 % (2.8 sigma)

notes.composition: multiset of the nonzero classes on the twenty faces of one carrier (carrier tier)
notes.history_sources: per-sweep compositions from the record files: L5 sweeps 0-600 (all), L6 0-80, L7 0-64, L8 0-4; after that the checkpoints (L6 every 50 to 500, L7 every 50 to 400, L8 every 50 to 300, L9 and L10 at 100, 200, 300)
notes.moves_between_carriers: EXACT: a face of a carrier changes only by a twist of one of its own 30 seams; glue seams carry screen plaquettes. Data: composition changes without an own-seam twist in that sweep = 0 at L5 (600 sweeps), L6 (80), L7 (64), L8 (4); total class content per carrier sums to 0 mod 6 on every checkpoint (CH). Content never moves to a neighbour.
notes.shape_symmetry: shapes up to the 60 proper rotations of the icosahedral template; a reflection maps class k to 6 - k, so the mirror image of a configuration of composition X is a configuration of the conjugate composition
notes.pair_correlation: g(r) = observed / expected pairs of carriers at angular distance r (units: mean spacing of adjacent cells), expected = same numbers placed at random on the carriers; error Poisson on the observed count; first shell (r < 0.5) is the carrier itself
